detail: Identify and validate 3 indie product ideas that leverage our technical stack (OpenClaw, marine knowledge, automation). Research market demand, competition, and effort-to-build. Update this task with findings and a ranked shortlist.
Research ClawHub skill marketplace gaps — find underserved niches where we could build and publish a paid or popular skill. Document opportunities in memory/product-ideas/

Explore freelance/contract automation opportunities on Upwork, Fiverr, and Australian freelance platforms. Focus on areas where AI agent + technical skills give us an edge. Log findings and refine criteria as market knowledge improves.

Investigate building a niche SaaS micro-tool we fully own. Candidates: compliance checklist apps, vessel maintenance trackers for independent operators, drone flight log tools — or anything better discovered during research. Pivot freely.

Research affiliate and referral programs for developer tools, hosting, and marine equipment. Find programs worth promoting through content or tools we build. Maintain a ranked list in memory/product-ideas/affiliate-programs.md

Draft a simple landing page or portfolio site showcasing our automation and AI agent capabilities. Target audience: small business owners who want AI automation but dont know where to start. Iterate on positioning as we learn what resonates.
Monitor and verify all 10 cron jobs fire correctly over first 48 hours. Log any failures or unexpected behaviour. Adjust schedules or prompts based on what we learn.
Build a kanban visual panel for the dashboard (dashboard-v2) that reads kanban-md task files and renders them as columns. Start simple, iterate.
Set up remote access to dashboard via Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale so Mat can check from phone. Document the approach chosen and why.
Improve overnight research quality — after first week, review what the overnight sessions actually produced. Tune prompts, adjust focus areas, remove waste. This is an ongoing optimisation task.
Create a weekly cost report template that tracks API spend vs value generated. Goal: understand ROI of agent operations and identify where to cut or invest more.

Deep dive into OpenClaw plugin and skill development — learn the full skill format, publishing pipeline, and what makes a skill successful on ClawHub. Document learnings as a reference guide in memory/research/
Research how other OpenClaw power users structure their agents for maximum autonomy. Study setups from madebynathan, veritas-kanban, DEV task board discussion. Extract patterns we can adopt.
Learn about Convex backend platform and their free tier for OpenClaw projects. Evaluate whether its worth using for any product ideas. Update product-ideas if relevant.
Explore FPV drone content creation as a side revenue stream — research YouTube monetisation, drone footage licensing, and whether Bosun can help automate editing or publishing workflows.
Review and consolidate memory files weekly. Archive stale notes, promote key learnings to MEMORY.md, keep workspace clean. This task never moves to done — its a recurring discipline.
Keep HEARTBEAT.md and cron prompts tuned based on real-world performance. If something isnt working, fix it. Log all changes in memory/cron-changes.md
